title: 1000-bunny wall-release pile

governing_assumptions: Same pure ABD solver and device block preconditioner as current runs.

geometry.description: 1000 original watertight bunnies, 10x10x10 grid with non-overlapping circumspheres; full five-wall container

discretization.refinement_plan: Full-size CUDA capacity gate before production; no silent coarsening.

materials.name: bunny
materials.provenance: Fixed numerical orthogonality penalty for the requested near-rigid trajectory; not a calibrated bunny material.

initial_conditions.state_variables: identity affine transforms, existing bunny rotations

boundary_conditions.description: bottom plus all four sides; right wall translates after time >=2 s and maximum surface speed <=0.15 m/s

time.stability_policy: Nominal1e-3s; recoverable failures roll back and halve dt, at most2retries per step, global minimum nominal/4; accepted increments sum from the recorded start_time to the target time. All convergence thresholds remain authoritative.

estimates.candidate_counts: Initial separated grid is small; settled/colliding counts must be measured by full-size CUDA gate and production overflow checks.

capacities.policy: Stop and retain failure on overflow/OOM; never drop contacts or change mesh to fit.

validation.expectation: 1000 bunnies; finite; wall released; runout >0.05 m; retained wall gap >1e-8 m
validation.tolerance: Target time1e-8s; fixed Newton velocity1e-5m/s; PCG absolute1e-12, relative0.
validation.evidence: Controlled CPU free translation/rotation at E2TPa and dt1e-3 reproduced energy creation with Newton0.05; fixed Newton1e-5 removed it at the same PCG1e-12. Fresh1000-body CUDA validation uses these fixed public settings; complete4s release/runout acceptance remains pending.
validation.timestep_policy: Nominal1e-3s; recoverable failures roll back and halve dt, at most2retries per step, global minimum nominal/4; accepted increments sum from the recorded start_time to the target time. All convergence thresholds remain authoritative.

assumptions: SI units, original geometry/density/friction/local damping, f64. Fixed orthogonality penalty2TPa, contact kappa8e12, Newton velocity1e-5, PCG absolute1e-12; thresholds never relax after failure.
Open-top container: bottom and four side walls; right wall removed only after settling.
User requested1e-3s for both large scenes and monitoring; bounded, recorded timestep reduction after failed trials. Complete impact/release physics still require production validation.
At1000bodies the initial CUDA pool is1GB; this is not the total VRAM requirement. The running prefix used about8953MiB; the full-run peak remains unverified.
unresolved: Complete4s CUDA wall-release/runout acceptance and full-trajectory capacity/energy/shape evidence remain pending.
